title: Note: your words into familiar cards, live

text: That is the Prompts tab's job and it will become the front of the board: as you speak, each idea becomes a card with a name, a two-sentence reading, and the sentences it came from; you refine by flagging a name or a sentence, and the card evolves under the same id. The declutter minion is clearing the noise around it now; the inbox brief makes the cards the thing you look at.
